import numpy as np
one=np.ones_like(t)
Tn=['1','t','t2','lt','1/t']; Pn=['1','P','P2','P3','lP','PlP','sP','1/P']
Tb=[one,t,t**2,np.log(t),1/t]; Pb2=[one,P,P**2,P**3,np.log(P),P*np.log(P),np.sqrt(P),1/P]
cols=[];nm=[]
for a,x in zip(Tn,Tb):
    for b,y in zip(Pn,Pb2):
        cols.append(x*y); nm.append(a+'*'+b)
A=np.column_stack(cols)
c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
for n,v in zip(nm,c):
    if abs(v)>1e-3: print(n, round(v,5))
# prune: keep terms with |c|*std(col)>1e-3 and refit
keep=[i for i in range(len(cols)) if abs(c[i])*cols[i].std()>0.02]
A2=A[:,keep]; c2,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A2,dP_dt,rcond=None)
r=A2@c2-dP_dt
print(len(keep),'NMSE %.3e'%(np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt)))
print([(nm[k],round(v,4)) for k,v in zip(keep,c2)])

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    lt = np.log(t)
    sP = np.sqrt(P)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*t + p[2]*lt + p[3]/t
            + (p[4] + p[5]*t + p[6]*lt)*sP
            + (p[7] + p[8]*t)*P + p[9]*P*np.log(P))
